document.name: Highbridge Voices at Merriam Ave
document.shortDescription: Highbridge afterschool music and enrichment program for grades 3-12 with weekday choir, music theory, STEM, art, and homework help at the Merriam campus.
document.longDescription:
Highbridge Voices at Merriam Ave is the organization's main Highbridge campus at 1360 Merriam Avenue in the Bronx. The official Merriam page says the campus is open Monday through Thursday from 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM for students in grades 3-12, and describes a well-rounded afterschool experience with homework help, STEM, art, music theory, choral training, and instrumental and musicianship classes.

The official Music Program page describes Highbridge Voices as a transformative afterschool initiative for students in grades 3-12 and says rehearsals are held Monday through Thursday from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM at the main campus. The broader program page also describes Highbridge Voices as a music and academic program dedicated to children and notes the Merriam Ave afterschool music program as an active application path for the 2025-2026 school year.

The official homepage says all Highbridge Voices students participate on a 100% scholarship. Published contact details across the official site list Highbridge Voices at 1360 Merriam Ave., Bronx, NY 10452, phone (718) 293-8759, and email info@highbridgevoices.org.

Sources: https://www.highbridgevoices.org/merriam/ https://www.highbridgevoices.org/music-program/ https://www.highbridgevoices.org/program/ https://www.highbridgevoices.org/2025-2026-application/ https://www.highbridgevoices.org/ https://www.highbridgevoices.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/061924_518-scaled.jpg
